properties.name: Great Sea Interconnector (Crete–Cyprus Subsea HVDC)
properties.subtype: 525 kV Monopolar / Bipolar VSC-HVDC Subsea Link
properties.operator: Independent Power Transmission Operator (IPTO / ADMIE) & GSI Ltd
properties.converterTech: Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) Voltage Source Converter
properties.description: Historic subsea HVDC interconnector ending Cyprus's absolute electrical isolation from the continental European grid (ENTSO-E). Enables bidirectional export of Cyprus solar energy and import of European firm balancing capacity.

properties.name: GSI Kofinou VSC-HVDC Converter Terminal
properties.subtype: High Voltage Direct Current Converter Station
properties.description: State-of-the-art Voltage Source Converter (VSC) station transforming 525 kV DC from the Mediterranean subsea cable into 132/400 kV AC for synchronization with the Cyprus national grid.

properties.name: GSI Zygi Sea-Ground Interface & Transition Pit
properties.description: Deepwater subsea armored cable touchdown point and underground transition vault directing HVDC land cables to Kofinou.
